_doc: A range past the content is a NO-OP: the document is unchanged and nothing is journaled. Controller::set_character_attribute has always documented this ('No-op when ... the range is out of bounds'), but split_range asserts in Rust and has a precondition in Swift, so this op CRASHED both active ports through the production op dispatcher. The golden is the setup document, unchanged.
name: tspan_set_attribute_past_the_content_is_a_noop

_doc: An INVERTED range (char_start > char_end) is a NO-OP too. It is the other half of the same guard: split_range asserts on it in Rust and splitTspanRange preconditions on it in Swift, and the past-the-content case above cannot witness this half. Same golden, the setup document unchanged.
name: tspan_set_attribute_inverted_range_is_a_noop
